review_method.unit: root, direct parent, canonical ledger, routed thread, parent anchor, assigned reply function, rendered reply, persona variant, and ordered recent thread context

cross_seed_interpretation.qualitative_finding: Both seeds produce coherent local governance and emotional-support threads after semantic thread routing and explicit root-versus-latest parent anchoring.
cross_seed_interpretation.frequency_finding: The assigned interaction-function mix remains seed-sensitive; seed-level reference-versus-synthetic Jensen-Shannon diagnostics are 0.1296 and 0.3878.
cross_seed_interpretation.interpretation: The pilot supports qualitative local-thread fidelity and safety boundaries, not stable population-level interaction-function frequencies.

observed_data_interpretation.finding: Observed pairs ground the function vocabulary and style constraints. Held-out lecture pairs remain evaluation-only; the synthetic function mix is a coverage probe rather than a fitted frequency distribution.

claim_boundary.next_gate: Use these 24 replies as the release evidence for local thread fidelity; do not claim population-share calibration until a larger multi-seed calibration run reduces seed sensitivity.
